coverage_semantics.note_vi: Dữ liệu hoạt động/giao dịch chuẩn chỉ sinh đến 2026-12-31. Ngày 2027-01-04 chỉ là T+1 terminal để tất toán hoặc reversal clearing cuối kỳ. Lịch phủ đến 2027-01-15 là vùng đệm cho phép tính ngày làm việc và rerun; không mở rộng kỳ mô phỏng và không cho sinh giao dịch kinh doanh mới sau 2026-12-31.

kyc.release_semantics_note_vi: EXPIRED là enum dự phòng cho dữ liệu nhập/di trú; release này không tự chuyển PASS sang EXPIRED, nên tỷ lệ EXPIRED sinh mới bằng 0.

product_version_selection.interval_predicate: booking_date >= effective_from AND (effective_to IS NULL OR booking_date <= effective_to)

records.generator_action: Materialize every date 2023-01-01..2027-01-15; apply 51 overrides; terminal T+1 of 2026-12-31 must be 2027-01-04.
After simulation_end_date run one business day; settle or validly reverse every item; terminal clearing balance must equal zero.
Select exactly one product_version whose effective interval contains booking_date; no current-version fallback.
Calibrate final debt group and outstanding to target 0.018 within 0.015-0.022, then recheck DEC-10 hard gates.
Calibrate positive active VND CASA / (CASA + ACTIVE TD principal) to target 0.38 within 0.34-0.42; exclude GTCG/interbank and recheck ALM/LDR.
Generate nine-term contract-count mix and active-principal balance mix; calibrate short-term funding / MLT loans to 0.85 within 0.80-0.90; recheck D01, D03, LDR and TD balance mix.
Use versioned debit/credit templates for inward and outward flows; inward mapping shares the root contract with WP-04.
For each injected dirty value persist injection id, source PK, dirty type, value hash, seed and timestamp.
Persist every eligible observation including label_flag=false with grain, denominator, rule version and deterministic seed.
Compute positive quota from rate x denominator after exclusion/cooldown; preserve CHURN and ROUND_TRIPPING carry-forward policies.
Generate PENDING then PASS/FAIL within five business days; reassessment must return through PENDING; latest event projects current status.
Generate four consecutive VND quarters before deriving TTM revenue_band; never use GR.DEFAULT.
Create salary anchor before sampling GR.INCOME_ANCHOR_SALARY; matrix-only, no marginal fallback.

Rank person customers by income_band descending, break ties by stable SHA-256, allocate MASS/UPPER_MASS/AFFLUENT/PRIORITY at 72/20/6/2 using largest remainder, and persist one open history interval. No random or GR.DEFAULT fallback.
Build all L4 facts and marts from declared upstream physical tables; do not synthesize them independently.
Persist internal and CIC debt groups; final_debt_group is the worse of the two and drives NPL metrics.
Persist assessment_date and optional journal link for monthly TOI and accounting traceability.

Generate auditable monthly OPEX and non-interest journals, calibrate DEC-10 metrics in deterministic order, derive the monthly KPI mart, recheck all hard gates, and never use KPI-only plug journals or an opening-equity knob.
Resolve legacy logical aliases before applying the instructor denylist; unknown objects remain INSTRUCTOR.

nim_ttm.note_vi: DEC-20: Earning assets = loan principal + overdraft + vốn dư đem gửi liên ngân hàng. NIM theo chuẩn ngành là NII trên bình quân tài sản sinh lời, mà tài sản sinh lời bao gồm tiền gửi liên ngân hàng. Ghi chú loại trừ cũ được viết khi schema chưa có nghiệp vụ này; generator nay đã hạch toán lãi tiền gửi liên ngân hàng trên vốn dư, nên nếu chỉ cộng thu nhập mà không cộng tài sản thì NIM bị thổi phồng giả tạo.

VAL.D21.sql_text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS branch_industry_band_violation FROM (SELECT cu.home_branch_id AS b, AVG(CASE WHEN COALESCE(o.industry_code,p.occupation_code) IN ('FNB','XAY_DUNG') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s FROM core_customer cu LEFT JOIN core_organization o ON o.party_id=cu.party_id LEFT JOIN core_person p ON p.party_id=cu.party_id WHERE COALESCE(o.industry_code,p.occupation_code) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) t WHERE (t.b='CN07' AND (t.s<0.45 OR t.s>0.55)) OR (t.b<>'CN07' AND (t.s<0.12 OR t.s>0.22))

vacuity_witness.population: khach hang co industry_code hoac occupation_code khac NULL
vacuity_witness.witness_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core_customer cu LEFT JOIN core_organization o ON o.party_id=cu.party_id LEFT JOIN core_person p ON p.party_id=cu.party_id WHERE COALESCE(o.industry_code,p.occupation_code) IS NOT NULL
vacuity_witness.rationale: Quan the van lon (~76% khach hang) nen day khong phai phep kiem rong.

VAL.D21.owner_reason: DEC-21: sua MAU SO, khong noi band. GR.INDUSTRY_BY_BRANCH khai P(nganh | chi nhanh) - mot phan phoi CO DIEU KIEN TREN NGANH. Nguoi ve huu, sinh vien, noi tro khong co nganh nen KHONG thuoc mien cua phan phoi do. Cau goc chia cho TOAN BO khach, dem nguoi khong di lam nhu bang chung 'chi nhanh khong chuyen F&B', lam loang dung bang ty le nguoi khong di lam (do duoc 22,6-26,5%). Tren mau so dung, generator trung giua band o MOI chi nhanh: CN07 0,5052 (band 0,45-0,55); CN03 0,1551; CN06 0,1628; CN01 0,1795 (band 0,12-0,22). Truoc khi sua, ba chi nhanh vi pham chi vi pha loang: CN07 0,3875; CN03 0,1170; CN06 0,1197.

VAL.T16.sql_text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_reversal_count FROM core_payment_order r LEFT JOIN core_payment_order o ON o.payment_order_id=r.source_reference WHERE r.payment_status='REVERSED' AND (o.payment_order_id IS NULL OR o.payment_status='REVERSED' OR o.payment_order_id=r.payment_order_id)

vacuity_witness.witness_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core_payment_order WHERE payment_status='REVERSED'
vacuity_witness.rationale: A reversal is testable when reversal rows exist; validity requires a distinct existing non-reversal source order.

VAL.T16.owner_reason: source_reference is NOT NULL, so validity is tested by resolving it to a distinct existing original order.

VAL.G05.sql_text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue_suspense_item_count FROM core_gl_entry WHERE gl_account_code='SUSPENSE_ACCOUNT'

vacuity_witness.rationale: SUSPENSE_ACCOUNT is forbidden on the release path; zero postings is a negative assertion over a populated GL, not an empty population.

VAL.G05.owner_reason: The release chart forbids suspense postings; any physical entry is a violation, irrespective of age.

VAL.D03.sql_text: WITH casa AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(b.current_balance,0)),0) amount FROM core_account_balance b JOIN core_account a USING(account_id) JOIN ref_product_version pv ON pv.product_version_id=a.product_version_id WHERE a.account_status='ACTIVE' AND a.currency='VND' AND pv.product_id IN ('CASA_IND','CASA_BIZ')), td AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.principal),0) amount FROM core_deposit_contract d JOIN core_contract c USING(contract_id) WHERE d.deposit_status='ACTIVE' AND c.currency='VND') SELECT casa.amount/NULLIF(casa.amount+td.amount,0) AS casa_funding_ratio FROM casa CROSS JOIN td
VAL.D03.owner_reason: Unified EOP current-state snapshot; no global max-date row loss.

VAL.CLR03.sql_text: WITH terminal AS (SELECT COALESCE(MIN(calendar_date) FILTER (WHERE calendar_date>DATE '2026-12-31'),MAX(calendar_date)) cutoff_date FROM ref_business_calendar WHERE calendar_id='VN_PUBLIC_ADMIN_5D-v1.0' AND is_business_day), ranked AS (SELECT s.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY payment_leg_id ORDER BY attempt_no DESC,status_event_at DESC,settlement_id DESC) rn FROM core_payment_settlement s,terminal t WHERE s.settlement_date<=t.cutoff_date) SELECT COUNT(*) terminal_open_or_unproven_count FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN core_gl_entry e ON r.closing_journal_id=e.journal_id AND e.settled_flag LEFT JOIN core_reversal_link x ON r.reversal_link_id=x.core_reversal_link_id WHERE r.rn=1 AND (r.settlement_status NOT IN ('SETTLED','REJECTED','RETURNED') OR (r.settlement_status='SETTLED' AND (r.closing_journal_id IS NULL OR e.gl_entry_id IS NULL)) OR (r.settlement_status IN ('REJECTED','RETURNED') AND (r.reversal_link_id IS NULL OR x.core_reversal_link_id IS NULL)))

vacuity_witness.population: latest settlement attempt per payment leg at the terminal calendar cutoff
vacuity_witness.witness_sql: WITH terminal AS (SELECT COALESCE(MIN(calendar_date) FILTER (WHERE calendar_date>DATE '2026-12-31'),MAX(calendar_date)) cutoff_date FROM ref_business_calendar WHERE calendar_id='VN_PUBLIC_ADMIN_5D-v1.0' AND is_business_day), ranked AS (SELECT s.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY payment_leg_id ORDER BY attempt_no DESC,status_event_at DESC,settlement_id DESC) rn FROM core_payment_settlement s,terminal t WHERE s.settlement_date<=t.cutoff_date) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked WHERE rn=1
vacuity_witness.rationale: Closure is asserted over every terminal latest attempt, including correctly closed rows; an empty open-item subset is the desired result.

VAL.CLR03.owner_reason: Terminal open items and terminal rows without closure/reversal evidence are violations.
